claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Diflunisal is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug whose only plausible cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM is weak cyclooxygenase-dependent anti-inflammatory/antiproliferative signaling, with no evidence of a dominant cytotoxic off-target at this concentration.
